Fix: restore original management-brain content, add v0.9.0 required fields, fix display name
Update frontmatter to ClawHub v0.9.0 format: add version field, metadata.openclaw runtime requirements (env, config), emoji, homepage
Updated listing: highlight zero-setup native mode, multi-storage (Notion/Sheets/Obsidian), 9 mentors, 6 culture packs, optional cloud

**Summary: Adds flexible, user-selectable storage integration (Notion, Google Sheets, Obsidian, local, etc.) for management data.**

- Storage backend can now be chosen at first run (Notion, Google Sheets, Obsidian, Google Drive, or local files)
- README and SKILL documentation updated to describe storage options and data formats
- Skill now recommends best storage based on available integrations
- Core commands and workflows (adding/listing employees, reports, summaries) reference the user’s chosen storage method instead of always local files
- No changes to mentor philosophies or check-in logic

**Major update: Adds OpenClaw-native, no-setup mode and simplifies usage for everyone.**

- Introduced OpenClaw Native Mode: Works instantly with your existing channels, no external registration or API key required.
- Redesigned employee management: Add, list, and manage employees directly in OpenClaw; data is stored locally.
- Simplified check-ins: AI sends mentor-style questions and chases employees using built-in communication actions.
- All existing mentor strategies, sentiment analysis, and culture packs still supported.
- Cloud Platform integration (manageaibrain.com) is now optional for advanced features.
- Documentation updated and streamlined; technical setup no longer required for basic use.

- Added detailed cultural adaptation section, including six predefined culture packs and specific adaptation rules per country.
- Clarified that culture packs can override mentor strategies when conflicts arise.
- Updated documentation to list all available culture packs and their key behavioral guidelines.
- No changes to API endpoints or core features.

AI Management Brain v1.1.0

- Expanded mentor philosophies from 8 to 9, now including Elon Musk and others.
- Added proactive integration with Telegram, Slack, and Lark for team check-ins and chasing.
- Introduced cultural adaptation—AI now auto-adjusts communication style per employee's background.
- Enhanced executive summaries and anomaly alerts (sentiment, engagement, consecutive misses).
- API documentation updated: new endpoints, channel info, and mentor-specific behavior details.
- README and skill description significantly improved for clarity and multi-language support (English/中文).
